units.source_text: 三个陌生的学生从遥远的城里，前往积雪颇厚的深山老林中的牧师馆，

en.t: Three unfamiliar students came from a distant city and went to the pastor's house deep in the mountains, where the snow lay thick,

units.source_text: 造访了这馆中的勤杂工，忽然向他提亲，

en.t: visited the handyman who worked there, and suddenly proposed a marriage arrangement to him,

units.source_text: 请他同意同他离家出走的女儿的婚事。

en.t: asking him to consent to a marriage with his daughter, who had run away from home.
The handyman was clearly at a loss,

units.source_text: 甚至狼狈得无法判明这三个求婚者中，究竟谁想娶自己的女儿。

en.t: and was so flustered that he could not even tell which of the three suitors actually wanted to marry his daughter.

units.source_text: 这桩上门提亲的事，使他听到离家三年杳无音信的女儿的消息。

en.t: This unexpected visit to ask for her hand brought him news of the daughter who had left home three years earlier and had not been heard from since.

units.source_text: 而且有事可以与之商量的牧师，为了避寒住在遥远的海边。

en.t: And the pastor, the one person he could have consulted about the matter, was staying far away by the sea to escape the cold.
